care_events_target_chk.name: care_events_target_chk
care_events_target_chk.value: ("care_events"."site_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("care_events"."spot_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

identifications_crop_chk.name: identifications_crop_chk
identifications_crop_chk.value:
("identifications"."crop_x" IS NULL AND "identifications"."crop_y" IS NULL AND "identifications"."crop_w" IS NULL AND "identifications"."crop_h" IS NULL)
        OR ("identifications"."crop_x" >= 0 AND "identifications"."crop_y" >= 0 AND "identifications"."crop_w" > 0 AND "identifications"."crop_h" > 0
        AND "identifications"."crop_x" + "identifications"."crop_w" <= 1.0001 AND "identifications"."crop_y" + "identifications"."crop_h" <= 1.0001)
